rules.statement: The doctrine of part performance cannot be applied to contracts governed by the Ceylon Ordinance No. 7 of 1840, as such contracts are deemed void ab initio and not merely voidable.
rules.supporting_quote: "Now a contract which is to be of no force and effect is void. No emphatic adjectives and no redundant repetition could express a conclusion of nullity more effectually than do the simple words which the Legislature has employed."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: No sale .... shall be of force or avail in law.
